report.title: 2025 Consumer Confidence Report - Burchell Road Water Association

sources_described: Water well(s): Well 4300567-001 (Well 1) and Well 4300567-002 (Well 2). The report states 'The water source is not considered most vulnerable to low density.'

extraction_notes: Scanned (image-only) PDF of the hand-filled state SWS CCR template; numbers were transcribed from page images rendered at 110 dpi. Tables 3-5 give separate results for Well #1 and Well #2, recorded as one entry per well with source_group. The 'About This Report' paragraph says the monitoring period is Jan 1 - Dec 31, 2024, but the title is '2025 Consumer Confidence Report', the report is dated February 6, 2026 and lead/copper, iron (Well #2) and conductivity samples are dated 2025, so data_year is recorded as 2025. Units are written in the 'Range of Detections' column instead of ranges; the turbidity row's MCL/PHG cells look shifted ('.1' / '5'). Table 8 detection counts are blank, so those three rows have value null and detected null. Table 6 is empty; Table 7 and Table 9 are 'None'; Tables 10-11 and the RTCR/variance sections are unfilled template text.
